mapper.select: SELECT id as ID, test_id as testId, name as name, description as description, priority as priority, status as status, created_at as createdAt, assignee as assignee, fix_due_date as fixDueDate, fixed_date as fixedDate, remarks as remarks, is_deleted as isDeleted, updated_at as updatedAt, pjt_id as pjtId, assigneeName, testName, priorityName, statusName FROM ( SELECT d.id, d.test_id, d.name, d.description, d.priority, d.status, d.created_at, d.assignee, d.fix_due_date, d.fixed_date, d.remarks, d.is_deleted, d.updated_at, d.pjt_id, COALESCE(u.name, d.assignee) as assigneeName, ut.TEST_CASE_NAME as testName, (CASE d.priority WHEN 'CR' THEN '긴급' WHEN 'HI' THEN '높음' WHEN 'MD' THEN '보통' WHEN 'LO' THEN '낮음' ELSE d.priority END) as priorityName, (CASE d.status WHEN 'NEW' THEN '신규' WHEN 'IPR' THEN '진행중' WHEN 'FIX' THEN '해결' WHEN 'REO' THEN '재오픈' WHEN 'COM' THEN '완료' ELSE d.status END) as statusName FROM defect d LEFT JOIN users u ON d.assignee = u.user_id LEFT JOIN unit_test_case ut ON d.test_id = ut.id WHERE d.id = #{id} AND d.is_deleted = 'N' ) A
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect ( id, test_id, name, description, priority, status, created_at, assignee, fix_due_date, fixed_date, remarks, is_deleted, updated_at, pjt_id ) VALUES ( #{id}, #{testId}, #{name}, #{description}, #{priority}, #{status}, NOW(), #{assignee}, #{fixDueDate}, #{fixedDate}, #{remarks}, 'N', NOW(), #{pjtId} )
mapper.update: UPDATE defect SET test_id = #{testId}, name = #{name}, description = #{description}, priority = #{priority}, status = #{status}, assignee = #{assignee}, fix_due_date = #{fixDueDate}, fixed_date = #{fixedDate}, remarks = #{remarks}, updated_at = NOW(), pjt_id = #{pjtId} WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
UPDATE defect SET is_deleted = 'Y', updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE defect SET fixed_date = NOW(), updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND is_deleted = 'N'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO defect_status_history ( id, defect_id, status, changed_at, changed_by, remarks ) VALUES ( CONCAT('DSH_', LPAD((SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id, 5) AS UNSIGNED)), 0) + 1 FROM defect_status_history dsh), 8, '0')), #{id}, #{status}, NOW(), #{assignee}, #{remarks} )
mapper.select: SELECT CASE WHEN MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id, 5) AS UNSIGNED)) IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE MAX(CAST(SUBSTRING(id, 5) AS UNSIGNED)) + 1 END as nextSequence FROM defect WHERE id REGEXP '^DEF_[0-9]{3}$' AND is_deleted = 'N'

SELECT d.id as ID, d.name as name, d.status as status, d.updated_at as updatedAt, d.assignee as assignee, ut.TEST_CASE_NAME as testName FROM defect d LEFT JOIN unit_test_case ut ON d.test_id = ut.id WHERE d.is_deleted = 'N' AND d.updated_at IS NOT NULL
AND d.pjt_id = #{pjtId}
ORDER BY d.updated_at DESC
LIMIT 10
